text.intro:
Four questions from walking through the Meeting tab with Ann on 9 Oct. Everything reads saved outputs of
the completed rank-70 runs; nothing is refitted except the Addis band areas in the last section.
Calibration set = IMPROVE filters a model is built on; cross-validation = IMPROVE sites held out of it;
test set = the Addis filters. Deming at MAC 10. "Spline" = AIRSpec; "VIBES cut" = the same VIBES correction
predicting from 4000–1425 cm⁻¹ only.
text.self:
**Yes, IMPROVE predicts itself, under both baselines.** Across seasons the held-out IMPROVE
filters have a near-zero intercept (FTIR vs TOR -0.18 to 0.60 µg/m³
over all splits, median 0.07) and slopes of 0.5–0.9, the expected PLS shrinkage at low
loadings. VIBES predicts IMPROVE *better* than spline (median cross-validation TOR R² 0.78 vs
0.58), yet its Addis intercept is far worse (median -4.74 vs -0.29 µg/m³).

The calibration sets are internally consistent; the problem is in how the Addis spectra transfer. IMPROVE
validation cannot see it, which matches the 8 Oct finding that the Addis intercept grows with the number of PLS
factors while IMPROVE test R² stays flat.
text.window:
**Mostly not the range.** For the seasonal calibrations, cutting VIBES to 4000–1425 cm⁻¹ closes only
0–32 % of the gap to spline (Kiremt -6.21 → -5.22 µg/m³,
spline -0.66; All Addis -6.08 → -5.15).

For the all-IMPROVE models the cut points in opposite directions, and both follow the number of PLS factors:
lot 251 full k 11 gives -4.35, cut k 7 gives -1.65;
both lots full k 4 gives -0.93, cut k 10 gives -2.50.
The meeting impression that "sensitivity looks like spline" came from the shape of one crossplot, not the
intercept. **The VIBES correction above 1425 cm⁻¹, and how many factors the model uses, carry the bias; the
fingerprint region adds a little.**
text.mass:
**Still an extrapolation in mass, but a far smaller one.** The Addis median is
41× the IMPROVE median in µg/m³ but 9× in µg per filter, and
5.4× vs 1.2× the IMPROVE 99th percentile. 78 % of Addis filters
are still above IMPROVE's 99th percentile in mass (all of them in concentration), so the calibration sees few
filters as heavily loaded as Addis.
text.hump:
**The broad hump near 1000 cm⁻¹ is silicate dust (Si-O), not sulfate.**
- Its maximum sits near **1035 cm⁻¹**, and relative to CH it is 2.6× the IMPROVE level in Belg,
  1.9× in Kiremt and 1.4× in Dry. Within Addis the 1000–1060 band tracks
  **Si (ρ 0.90) and Al (0.92)**.
- The **sulfate** band (~1100 cm⁻¹) tracks sulfate (0.72) and ammonium (0.78),
  but relative to CH it is no stronger in Addis than in IMPROVE (0.0230 vs 0.0273).
- Separately, sharp **PTFE** features at ~1153 and ~1210 cm⁻¹ are 3.7× IMPROVE: filter-substrate
  signal the VIBES background leaves on Addis filters.
- These features explain what the Addis spectra look like; they have not yet been shown to explain the EC bias
  (dropping the PTFE window from VIBES calibrations on 8 Oct did **not** reduce the Addis intercept).
